ess-beta-metadata.label: Gross disposable household income per head
ess-beta-metadata.subtitle: Average income per person (£) after taxes and direct benefits
ess-beta-metadata.longDescription: This indicator shows an estimate of the amount of money each individual within a household has available for spending or saving after they have paid taxes and received any direct benefits, in pounds, in the UK, for 1997 to 2023.
ess-beta-metadata.caveats:
The latest [GDHI data](https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/regionalaccounts/grossdisposablehouseholdincome/bulletins/regionalgrossdisposablehouseholdincomegdhi/previousreleases) has been published but is not yet available on this service. The data will be added to Explore Local Statistics shortly after it becomes available on [Nomis](https://www.nomisweb.co.uk/datasets/gdhi).

Figures for 2023 are provisional, as national estimates have not been through supply and use balancing at the time of the data source publication.
